search.placeholder: Search a title or paste a link
search.noResultsHint: Try the original title or fewer words.
search.setupText: Searching needs a TMDB API key, and downloading needs at least one addon.
home.emptyTitle: What do you want to download?
home.emptyText: Search for a movie or series and tap ↓ to download it. You can also paste the link of a YouTube video or playlist.

sheet.searching.one: Looking for sources on the configured addon…

sheet.noStreamsHint: The configured addons returned no streams for this title.

sheet.onlyUnsupported.one: There is only 1 torrent source, which NoStream can't download.
sheet.onlyUnsupported.other: There are only {n} torrent sources, which NoStream can't download.

sheet.hlsDeviceOnly: HLS streams are converted while they reach the device: they can't be prepared on the server.

queue.allFailed.one: The only source tried didn't work. Error: {msg}
queue.allFailed.other: No source worked ({n} tried). Last error: {msg}

queue.blocked: The download didn't start: the browser may have blocked it. Allow multiple downloads for this site and tap Retry.
queue.notResumed: Download interrupted and not resumed by the browser
queue.stalled: Download stuck: no data for 10 minutes
queue.removedActive: Removed from downloads: the one already started in the browser keeps going
queue.serverGone: The file is no longer on the server
status.interrupted: Connection interrupted, waiting for the browser to resume · {of}
status.preparing: On the server · connecting to the source…
downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.keepOpen: Downloads go through this page: keep it open until they finish. The screen stays on by itself, where the browser allows it.
downloads.paused: Paused: queued items wait until you tap Resume.
downloads.pausedToast: Paused: the download already started keeps going, the others wait
downloads.emptyText: Open a movie or series and tap ↓.
downloads.serverHint: Files saved on the server's disk: they reach this device in a few seconds. They're deleted automatically 3 days after last use.
settings.title: Settings
settings.directFirstHint: They download faster, with size and resume
settings.prefsHint: These preferences decide the source picked automatically when you tap ↓. They apply to this device only.
addons.lead: The Stremio addons NoStream gets its sources from. The manifest URL is enough: the name is read automatically.
addons.emptyText: Add at least one with HTTP streams (not torrents).
nuvio.lead: Install NoStream as an addon in Nuvio: when you search for a title, NoStream entries to download will appear.
nuvio.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the URL and copy it manually
nuvio.howto: In Nuvio: Settings → Addons → paste the URL. Then long-press a NoStream entry and choose Download. For whole series, the Downloads page of this web app is more reliable.
tmdb.lead: It's used to search titles and read seasons and episodes. It's free: create an account and request a “Developer” key at
advanced.timeoutHint: Slower addons are skipped. The lower it is, the sooner the source list appears.
advanced.hlsHint: How many HLS streams the server converts at once. Direct files have no limit.
welcome.tmdbText: It's used to search movies and series. The key is free, get it at
welcome.addonsText: Paste the manifest URL of a Stremio addon with HTTP streams. The name is read automatically.
welcome.nuvioText: Optional: install NoStream as an addon in Nuvio to download right from the app.
link.readingHint: A long playlist may take a few seconds.
ytdlp.lead: Paste the link of a video or playlist into the search (YouTube and the other sites supported by yt-dlp). The server downloads the file and then passes it to the device.
ytdlp.numberFilesHint: “01 - Title”, so they stay in order
ytdlp.autoUpdateHint: At startup and once a day
ytdlp.upToDate: yt-dlp is already up to date ({v})
ytdlp.note: YouTube changes often: if downloads stop working, updating yt-dlp almost always fixes it. Only download content you have the right to keep.
addons.confirmUnuse: Stop using “{name}” as a source? It stays installed in Nuvio; you can turn it back on from Nuvio account.
welcome.fromNuvio: Get the addons from your Nuvio account
nuvioAcc.lead: Sign in with your Nuvio account: NoStream reads the addons you installed in Nuvio and uses as sources the ones that provide movie and series streams. If you add an addon in Nuvio, it shows up here by itself.
nuvioAcc.privacy: The password is only used for this sign-in and is not saved: NoStream keeps an access token on the server, which you can revoke by disconnecting the account. NoStream only reads and never changes your Nuvio account.
nuvioAcc.addonsTitle: Addons in Nuvio ({n}) · used as sources: {used}
nuvioAcc.noAddons: No addons in this Nuvio profile.
nuvioAcc.hint: Only addons that provide movie and series streams can be sources. The order is Nuvio's. NoStream re-reads the list every 6 hours.
nuvioAcc.confirmLogout: Disconnect the Nuvio account? Addons taken from Nuvio will no longer be used as sources.
plugins.none: There are no plugin repositories in your Nuvio account.
plugins.useAllHint: Plugins look for links on their own sites, like Nuvio does on the phone
plugins.confirmEnable: Plugins are programs written by third parties: NoStream runs them on the server in a closed process, without access to the server's files, but with internet access. Turn them on?
plugins.security: Plugins run in a separate process that can't read or write the server's files (settings, keys, downloads) and can't start other programs. They only receive the title's TMDB id and your TMDB API key, as in Nuvio.
nuvio.urlsLan: Addon URL (one for each network of the PC: use the one on the phone's network)
nuvio.noLan: The PC doesn't seem to be on a local network: the phone can't reach it.
nuvio.firewall: The first time, Windows asks whether to allow NoStream network access: choose “Private networks”, otherwise the phone can't reach it. The PC must stay on while you use NoStream from Nuvio.
srv.missingEpisode: Series need a season and an episode
srv.noImdb: No IMDb ID found for this title
srv.noAddons: No sources configured: add an addon in Settings → Addons, or connect your Nuvio account
srv.badManifestUrl: Manifest URL missing or not valid
srv.fileGone: The file is no longer on the server
srv.prepHls: HLS stream: conversion already happens on the server, use “Download”
srv.srcRange: the source returned a different part than requested
srv.srcNoSize: the source doesn't declare the file size
srv.noSpace: not enough disk space on the server
srv.srcEmpty: the source closed without sending data
srv.ytdlpMissing: yt-dlp is not installed on the server
srv.nuvioExpired: Nuvio session expired: connect the account again
srv.tmdbNoKey: TMDB API key not set: enter it in Settings → TMDB
srv.tmdbBadKey: TMDB rejects the API key (HTTP 401): check it in Settings → TMDB
srv.torrentOnly: Stream not supported: no direct URL available (torrent only)
srv.tooManyHls: Too many conversions in progress, try again shortly
srv.noFfmpeg: ffmpeg is not installed or not in the PATH
srv.upstreamTimeout: Timeout: the stream didn't respond within {s} s
srv.prep.title: 📦 Prepare on the server
srv.prep.hint: You can close this page: the download continues on the server. Go back to Nuvio and reopen the stream list: when it's ready you'll find the entry “✅ Ready on the server”, which downloads in a few seconds.
srv.addon.description: Download to your device the movies and series found by NoStream's sources
srv.addon.directDetails: Direct file{size} · downloaded on the server and passed to the phone as it arrives, resumable
srv.addon.hlsDetails: HLS · converted on the fly on the server: size known only when conversion ends, resumable
srv.addon.readyDetails: Already downloaded on the server{size} · arrives in a few seconds over your home network
srv.addon.preparingDetails: Being prepared on the server: you can download it now, the rest arrives as it goes
srv.addon.prepareDetails: Download the file on the server without using the phone; when it's ready you'll find it here as “✅ Ready on the server”
nuvio.lead2: NoStream offers two addons for Nuvio: install the one you need, or both.
nuvio.watchText: To watch right away: for each movie or episode a single link per resolution (4K, 1080p, 720p…), already tested by NoStream and therefore working.
nuvio.downloadText: To download to the phone: the “Downloadable”, “Needs converting” and “Prepare on the server” entries.
srv.watch.description: One verified link per resolution, ready to watch, from NoStream's sources
nuvioAcc.useDisabledAddons: Also use addons disabled in Nuvio
nuvioAcc.useDisabledHint: This way you can keep only NoStream enabled in Nuvio: NoStream queries the sources. Don't uninstall them, just disable them.
nuvioAcc.disabledButUsed: disabled in Nuvio, used by NoStream
plugins.useDisabled: Also use plugins disabled in Nuvio
plugins.useDisabledHint: Applies to plugin repositories disabled in the app
